motivation: E17C computed homogeneous force-free propagation; E17D0 separately derives a retarded linear Newtonian gravitational forcing functional per unit external potential from frozen F(q). It cannot determine a physical finite-K long-short halo/tracer bispectrum without specified source potential history, self-gravity and calibrated tracers.

physical_equation_and_scope.background: Original frozen positive isotropic F_state(q) 4000-q CSV; piecewise-linear F on strictly original q in [0,20] as numerical interpretation, no fit or extrapolation. Fixed epoch leading nonrelativistic comoving Newtonian Vlasov, no actual cosmological time supplied.
physical_equation_and_scope.equation: partial_eta delta_f + i[k dot qhat] q Tnu0/(a mnu) delta_f = i (a mnu/Tnu0) [k dot qhat] F'_state(q) psi_ext(k,eta). Here q is dimensionless original E8 q, eta and k are consistent conformal-comoving units c=1; psi_ext is a dimensionless external Newtonian potential. Force-source equation describes a linear response functional, not specified physical halo psi or self-consistent metric. No claim that all massive neutrino perturbation terms are represented.
physical_equation_and_scope.retarded_formal_solution: delta_f(k,qhat,q,eta) = integral_{eta0}^{eta} d eta' exp[-i k mu int_{eta'}^{eta} d eta'' q Tnu0/(a(eta'')mnu)] * i a(eta')mnu/Tnu0 k mu F'(q) psi_ext(k,eta'), plus initial free-streamed delta_f(eta0). E17D0 numerics compute only a fixed-epoch dimensionless angular impulse shape, not this full varying-a history or initial perturbation.
physical_equation_and_scope.fixed_epoch_impulse_shape: H_F(s) = -[integral_{qmin}^{qmax} dq q^2 F'_state(q) sinc'(s q)]/[integral_{qmin}^{qmax} dq q^2 F_state(q)]; s=(k/k0)*s0; k0=0.05 h/Mpc; normalized response to a symbolic unit k a mnu/Tnu0 integral psi_ext d eta. No external psi chosen, no actual eta or amplitude; do NOT multiply by E14/E15 S to form B.
physical_equation_and_scope.sinc_prime: sinc'(x)=(x cos x - sin x)/x^2, limit 0 at x=0; sinc''(x)= -sin(x)/x -2 cos(x)/x^2 +2 sin(x)/x^3, limit -1/3 at x=0.
physical_equation_and_scope.exact_finite_support_boundary: Independent integration-by-parts identity H_F(s)=(-[q^2 F(q) sinc'(s q)]_{qmin}^{qmax} + integral dq F(q)[2q sinc'(s q)+s q^2 sinc''(s q)])/I_F. Retain measured finite-q upper boundary; never pretend qmax=20 equals infinity.
physical_equation_and_scope.numerical_derivative: Use exact interval slopes of piecewise-linear original 4000-q F, not post-hoc smoothing or new distribution. Both GL2 Gauss nodes per original interval; denominator exact cubic-polynomial integral or identical GL2.
physical_equation_and_scope.small_s_identity: At fixed original finite support H_F(s)/s -> -1 + ([q^3 F(q)]_qmin^qmax)/(3 I_F), as s->0. Check original k0 with prospective positive s_test=1e-4 (not a new observational grid or phase fit).
physical_equation_and_scope.mathematical_symmetries: H_F(0)=0 and H_F(-s)=-H_F(s), under real Fourier reversal no new imaginary amplitude; short-leg exchange under k_center flip, unsampled -0.6 checked analytically without adding E16 orientation. As K/k->0 k1,k2 approach k, H_F(s1),H_F(s2) approach original center H_F(k/k0*s0). These only characterize source functional, not physical B.
physical_equation_and_scope.reference: Ma & Bertschinger ApJ 455 (1995) 7, doi:10.1086/176550, massive-neutrino conformal Newtonian Boltzmann equation; Newtonian leading nonrelativistic external-potential specialization is limited and does not replace full GR terms.
